welcome.s1_title: Your car park near the airport
welcome.s1_body: Compare partner car parks: the price shown is the total for your stay, shuttle included.
welcome.s2_body: Card payment, secured by Stripe. Everything is paid when you book: nothing to pay at the car park.
welcome.s3_body: Let the car park know you're coming from your booking, then the shuttle takes you to the terminal.
welcome.s4_body: Your flight is tracked: the shuttle picks you up at the meeting point and you get your car back.

search.s1_body: When you drop off the car and when you pick it up: the prices shown will be the total for your stay.
search.s2_body: Partner car parks free on your dates, with their total price and their shuttle.
search.s3_body: “View on the map” shows the car parks and the shuttles on the road, live.
search.s4_body: They're saved on this phone. Booked on the website? Add it with its reference and your email.

booking.s1_body: The dates, the car park and your booking reference.
booking.s2_body: Let the car park know: “I'm on my way”, “I'll be there in 20 min”… The team is expecting you.
booking.s3_body: Your flight is tracked: follow the shuttle live, then get your car back.
booking.s4_body: A wash or a charge while you're away: order them here.

pro_welcome_driver.s1_body: Two tabs for the day: Shuttle and Planning. “More” holds the rest.
pro_welcome_driver.s2_body: In “Out”, tick the customers getting on, even “Expected”, then go: the destination comes from their booking (terminal, station…).
pro_welcome_driver.s3_body: In “Back”, the customers to fetch, in order of return. Flights are tracked: the time moves with the landing.
pro_welcome_driver.s4_body: Choose it in More › My vehicle. On arrival, “Customers dropped off” or “Everyone's on board”: each customer moves to the next step.

pro_welcome_valet.s1_body: Three tabs for the day: Car park, Today and Spaces. “More” holds the rest.
pro_welcome_valet.s2_body: In “Arrivals to park”, the app suggests the row or space where the car won't block any return. Note the key hook.
pro_welcome_valet.s3_body: “To move out today” counts the cars to move so today's returns can get out. The goal: 0.
pro_welcome_valet.s4_body: Search by plate, name or reference: the row or space and the key hook are shown.

pro_welcome_agent.s1_body: Three tabs for the day: Today, Bookings and Car park. “More” holds the rest.
pro_welcome_agent.s2_body: Arrivals, returns, shuttles and what needs doing now, from most to least urgent.
pro_welcome_agent.s3_body: Search by name, plate or reference. Comparator emails come in by themselves; phone and counter bookings are entered here.
pro_welcome_agent.s4_body: On each booking, a single “Next step” button: park, drop off, pick up, return.

pro_welcome_manager.s1_body: Today, Bookings and Car park for the day; “More” holds the team, settings, plan and revenue.
pro_welcome_manager.s2_body: Arrivals, returns, shuttles and what needs doing now, then the month's revenue.
pro_welcome_manager.s3_body: Every day, a code to join the car park: give it to your staff, then accept their request in More › Team.
pro_welcome_manager.s4_body: Plan and valet rows, shuttle vehicles, extra services: it's all set up in “More”.

pro_today.s1_body: Switch from the overview to the list of today's arrivals and returns.
pro_today.s2_body: What needs the team now, from most to least urgent.
pro_today.s3_body: Flights, texts, notifications, payments and email import: “Check” when one of them needs your attention.

pro_reservations.s1_body: By name, plate, phone or reference.
pro_reservations.s2_body: The list starts with today's arrivals; “Earlier bookings” goes back in time.
pro_reservations.s3_body: For a customer on the phone or at the counter. Comparator emails come in by themselves.

pro_shuttle.s1_body: “Out”: customers to take. “Back”: those to fetch. “On the way”: your current trip.
pro_shuttle.s2_body: Each time groups the customers to take together, with their destination. “Tick all” takes the whole slot.
pro_shuttle.s3_body: The button says where you're going, based on the people ticked: “Go to TGV station · 6 pax”. It leaves with your vehicle for the day.

pro_occupation.s1_body: Plate, name or reference: the space or row, and the key hook.
pro_occupation.s2_title: The car park at a glance
pro_occupation.s2_body: Cars on site and, in a car park with rows, those to move out today before a return.
pro_occupation.s3_body: The app suggests where to put each car so it doesn't block any return.
pro_occupation.s4_body: Stays space by space, or row by row, over the coming days.

pro_start.s1_body: Address and number of spaces in More › Settings; the plan and valet rows are drawn in the web pro area, and the app picks them up.
pro_start.s2_title: Your bookings come in by themselves
pro_start.s2_body: Give your Plazo address (…@plazo.fr) to each comparator: every email creates the booking. For phone bookings, enter them in Bookings.
pro_start.s3_title: Your team and the daily code
pro_start.s3_body: Add your drivers, valets and front desk in More › Team, or give them the daily code: they join the car park with Apple or Google.
pro_start.s4_body: Your vehicles in service in More › Shuttle vehicles. Each driver takes their vehicle for the day; the Shuttle tab tells them who to take and who to fetch.
pro_start.s5_body: The price grid and the listing travellers see on plazo.fr, and your own PDF contract signed at the counter: set up in the web pro area.
pro_start.s6_body: The day-before text goes out at the time you choose. Each member sets their notifications in More › Notifications.
